verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own docs say it ships pre-built triggers for thousands of integrated apps, plus native Email, HTTP/Webhook and RSS triggers. Its event sources can be deployed and streamed, which delivers the core of triggering workflows from connected-app events. A community user describes an Airtable base that auto-feeds into Algolia, which loosely corroborates app-event triggering. missing for 10: explicit documentation of specific event types such as new-record and form-submission triggers, stronger independent hands-on corroboration of app-event triggers.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS
You can also consume events emitted by sources using Pipedream's REST API or a private, real-time SSE stream.
create a search widget powered by a client-editable Airtable base that auto-feeds into an Algolia index
